brief:
British student Finn Joughin, 22, was detained and deported from occupied Palestinian territory following his participation in a solidarity program in Masafer Yatta, the Shehab Wire reported. Joughin had traveled to the South Hebron Hills community as part of an international initiative supporting Palestinians, but the visit ended with his arrest and removal from the territory.

The incident underscores the risks faced by foreign activists engaged in Palestinian solidarity work in occupied areas. Masafer Yatta has long served as a focal point for Palestinian resistance to Israeli policies and has attracted international volunteers and observers documenting conditions on the ground. Israeli authorities have frequently detained foreign nationals participating in such activities, citing security concerns.
